text: 你和学生们走出来查看屠杀现场。恐狼的头颅虽然沉重，却足以成为你们发现的有力证据。西尔维娅开始处理它，以便带回文明世界。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 287
text: You emerge with your students to survey the slaughter. Although heavy, a dire wolf’s head would be convincing proof of your discoveries. Sylvia prepares it for transport back to civilization.
